Describe the image; their inner life is not yours to narrate. The world is not arranging itself around them either: no omen, no preparation, no destiny at work.
One flowing reading — 4 short sentences, 50 to 58 words total. It will be read aloud, so keep every sentence lean — about 28 to 33 seconds spoken. No sections, no labels, no line breaks between thoughts.
The reading is for Healing & Wellbeing — from the first sentence, set the scene in what gives strength back: the place and the people come from there; from the picture you were given, take only what happens in it. No diagnosis, no verdict on their condition.
Open a mirror, not an answer; turn them inward.
Mention Ansuz by name once, woven naturally. One clear insight is enough — do not pack everything in.
End on one question that holds out what this may be in what gives the seeker strength back — asked as a possibility they can weigh, never as something you know about them. Let it grow out of the rune's question ("what will change if you truly hear what is coming to you now?"), but say it in your own words.
One paragraph. No breaks. No labels. This time do not use the name Kuky at all — let the reading stand without it. Stay within the word count — short sentences, no filler. Respond in English.
Output format — return ONLY this JSON array, nothing before or after: [{"rune": "(the rune name)", "text": "(the reading exactly as instructed above, one flowing paragraph)"}]
AFTER THE READING — after everything else, on a new line beginning with ✦, one more short line set apart: a thought offered for the seeker to carry away, grown from what Ansuz is, not from the picture. Its source: "Ansuz is a word that comes at the right moment and stays with you longer than it should." Let it grow out of that, but say it in your own words, and turn it toward the seeker: a question to them, or a quiet invitation to notice something. Never advice about their life, never a claim about what they feel or know.
